'''X1's Fortress''' was the name of the base of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[X1]], established by him on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The facility was heavily armed, filled with [[Hovertank/Legends|hovertanks]], blasters, [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] equipment, and even old [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. X1 was defeated when the base was [[Battle of Mustafar (Galactic Civil War)|attacked]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
